name: Family Bowling 3D
description:
A bowling game featuring Billy, Sarah, Daddy, and Mommy!

The three game modes include Main Mode, where you'll battle your fellow family members; Free Play, where you can play as you like with 1-4 players; and Challenge Mode, where you can take difficult challenges head on! Aim for a perfect game in all of the five different stages we've assembled!
disclaimer: You may need an additional compatible SD card or SDHC card with available space to download this software. Visit support.nintendo.com for information about storage options. Sold separately.
